rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=2, train_n=400, n_iter=30, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=900, seed=42, rationale=iter-5 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: image-domain BF RANGE sigma img_sr 0.02->0.0005 (much tighter intensity bandwidth -> edge-preserving). Back to proj_n_bf=1/img_n_bf=1/n_iter=30 (iter-4 proj depth2 was hr=0 SSIM0.9563 recon_rmse9.85e-4 ~= base9.84e-4 -> projection axis also FBP-bounded). TRAJECTORY so far (all hr=0): depth (img & proj), n_iter/early-stop all asymptote to FBP from above, never below. HYPOTHESIS: the failure is edge-BLINDNESS -- a wide range sigma (0.02) lets the BF average across fibroglandular tissue edges (over-smooth). A TIGHT img_sr=0.0005 (the old-split breast N2I champion value) makes the range kernel edge-preserving: it smooths flat noise but STOPS at intensity edges, so the recon could retain detail AND denoise -> first real shot at recon_rmse < baseline (hr>0). If STILL hr=0, edge-preservation via range sigma does not unlock breast N2I either. FAILURE watched: too-tight img_sr -> BF becomes near-identity (no denoising) -> recon = raw noisy FBP (SSIM/PSNR ~ baseline, not below). BUDGET: img_sr is a VALUE change, same kernel/unfold cost as iter-3 (1047s); outer_wall_s tightened 1050->900 to keep total safely under the 30-min sbatch wall (iter-4 proj-depth2 ran 25 min). ONE knob: img_sr 0.02->0.0005.
